observations: Large stacks of blue plastic drums photographed outdoors in a storage yard on bare dirt.
Drums show weathering: rust-colored staining around metal bung rings, scuffed and faded plastic.
Stickers/labels are visible on several drums but text is too small/blurred to read.
Photos appear to show a bulk lot (many dozens of drums), not a single item.
Watermark reads 'EMMALINK CONCEPT NIG' in both images, consistent with a seller/vendor stamp, not proof of product condition.

claims.claim: Plastic drum for storage of any kind of liquid
claims.evidence: No close-up shows interior condition, cap/seal integrity, or confirms food-grade vs chemical-grade plastic; rust stains near bung rings suggest prior industrial use.

risks.risk: Drums may have previously held chemical or hazardous liquids, making them unsuitable for food/water storage.
risks.proof: Close-up photo of the label/sticker on a drum, or seller statement on prior contents with a photo of the manufacturer stamp.
risks.if_unproven: priced as industrial-grade/non-food-safe reuse drum, not potable-water-safe

risks.risk: Structural integrity (cracks, warping, weak seams) not visible in wide shots.
risks.proof: Close-up photos of the drum body, base, and bung caps, plus a water-fill or pressure test clip.
risks.if_unproven: priced as used condition with possible defects, not as new/leak-tested

risks.risk: Capacity/size not stated; drums could be 150L, 200L, or 210L which changes value per unit.
risks.proof: Photo of a capacity marking/embossed liter mark on the drum body.
risks.if_unproven: priced at the lower end of common used-drum capacity (assume ~200L standard) until confirmed

risks.risk: Lid/cap and gasket condition (whether it seals) not shown.
risks.proof: Close-up of an opened and closed bung cap with gasket visible.
risks.if_unproven: priced as cap/seal unconfirmed, i.e. may need replacement

risks.risk: Quantity being sold per listing (single drum vs whole stack) is ambiguous from photos alone.
risks.proof: Seller confirmation of unit count included in the price, ideally with one drum marked/tagged.
risks.if_unproven: priced as cost per single drum only

proof_requests: Close-up photo of one drum's label/manufacturer stamp and capacity marking.
Close-up of the bung caps and gasket condition.
A short video or photo showing the drum holding water without leaks.
Confirmation of exact liter capacity and whether sold per unit or per lot.
response.reason: This is a generic, identifiable-by-type item (used plastic storage drum); despite unverified claims about liquid suitability and condition, it can be priced at its worst case as a used, non-food-grade-unconfirmed industrial drum of standard capacity.
